## Corpus case

Case ID and proposal issue:

## Evidence review

- [ ] Every material factual claim is supported by a listed source.
- [ ] Source type and methodology are described accurately.
- [ ] Causal language does not exceed the evidence.
- [ ] Contrary evidence and measurement limitations are recorded.
- [ ] Transfer and non-transfer conditions are explicit.
- [ ] A success-only narrative has not hidden failures or trade-offs.

## Rights review

- [ ] The contribution is independently written factual metadata.
- [ ] It contains no copied article, paywalled case text, image, chart, table or proprietary dataset.
- [ ] Each source is linked rather than reproduced.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under `DATA_LICENSE.md`.
- [ ] Conflicts of interest are disclosed below.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run knowledge:ingest -- /absolute/path/case.json`
- [ ] `npm run knowledge:validate`
- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Every commit contains a DCO `Signed-off-by` line.
